adjudication_policy: claim-first corpus review; retrieval mode, rank, and pass/fail were not acceptance criteria

cases.expected_claim: Harmony documents the minimum integration arguments and its default PCA-embedding behavior.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed Harmony documentation states the minimum RunHarmony arguments and the default PCA embedding behavior directly.

cases.historical_review: Historical parameter-labelled spans remain exact-rank diagnostics; only the direct documented API/default statement is accepted for this claim.

cases.expected_claim: Harmony outputs adjusted cell coordinates with the same dimensions as the input embedding.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The method source explicitly states that Harmony outputs a matrix of adjusted coordinates with the same dimensions as its input matrix.

cases.historical_review: Benchmark figures and downstream metrics are retained as historical exact candidates but are not treated as direct Harmony output evidence.

cases.expected_claim: Scanorama is a method for batch correction and integration of heterogeneous single-cell RNA-seq datasets.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed Scanorama source directly identifies the tool and its supported batch-correction and heterogeneous scRNA-seq integration task.

cases.historical_review: Installation, troubleshooting, and example fragments remain reproducibility diagnostics but do not independently establish the supported task.

cases.expected_claim: Scanorama accepts multiple single-cell datasets represented as AnnData objects or compatible cell-by-gene matrices.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The Scanorama API documentation shows AnnData inputs and distinguishes integrated embeddings from corrected cell-by-gene matrices.
The governed source specifies the supported tabular input orientation with genes as rows and cells as columns.

cases.historical_review: The historical exact set contained one API span; a second corpus-grounded input-format span is accepted because it directly states matrix orientation.

cases.expected_claim: Scanorama is evaluated with batch-removal and biological-conservation metrics used in the governed integration benchmark.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed integration benchmark includes Scanorama and directly enumerates kBET, graph connectivity, ASW, and graph iLISI evaluation metrics.

cases.historical_review: README runtime and memory statements are not accepted as evaluation-metric evidence; the benchmark source is added through explicit claim-level review.

cases.expected_claim: scvi-tools documents concrete training settings including epoch warmup, maximum epochs, early stopping, and batch size.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed scvi-tools source reports exact n_epochs_kl_warmup, max_epochs, early-stopping, transfer-epoch, and batch-size settings.
The method supplement states optimizer, minibatch, parameter-clamping, and validation early-stopping behavior for the implementation.

cases.historical_review: Generic preprocessing and benchmark settings are retained as historical exact candidates but only direct scvi-tools training settings are accepted.

cases.expected_claim: scvi-tools produces learned latent or posterior representations that support downstream analysis and model sharing.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The scvi-hub method source directly describes low-dimensional posterior parameters and their normalized reconstructed representation.
The governed application source documents transferred query latent spaces and derived model outputs used for downstream comparison.

cases.historical_review: Integration benchmark plots and metrics remain historical retrieval diagnostics; accepted evidence is limited to direct scvi-tools representation outputs.

cases.expected_claim: CellTypist is an automated cell-type annotation tool trained from curated reference labels.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The source explicitly describes CellTypist as a tool for automated cell-type annotation in the pan-tissue immune study.
The governed publication record identifies CellTypist and its cell-type annotation method scope.

cases.historical_review: Large paper and README chunk pools remain exact-retrieval diagnostics; acceptance is restricted to direct tool-and-task statements.

cases.expected_claim: CellTypist annotation requires log-normalized expression, while training also requires expression data and annotation labels.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The CellTypist documentation explicitly requires a logarithmized, normalized expression matrix and states its normalization scale.
The training documentation directly enumerates gene-expression data, cell annotation labels, and optional gene inputs.

cases.historical_review: Visualization and study-context spans remain historical candidates but are not accepted as direct input requirements.

cases.expected_claim: CellTypist model performance is reported with precision, recall, and global F1 score.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The source directly reports CellTypist precision, recall, and global F1 score near 0.9 at both hierarchy levels.

cases.historical_review: The three historical metric-labelled chunks are figure, marker, or unrelated context fragments and remain exact diagnostics only.

cases.expected_claim: CellRank documents concrete analysis parameters and defaults for trend clustering and transport-map processing.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The CellRank method source directly reports Louvain trend clustering with resolution set to 0.2.
The CellRank 2 source explicitly documents the transport-map thresholding parameter used for scalability.

cases.historical_review: Simulation-specific and downstream settings remain historical exact candidates unless they directly describe a CellRank parameter.

cases.expected_claim: CellRank outputs initial and terminal states, fate probabilities, and global fate maps.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The CellRank 2 source has a dedicated key-outputs section describing consistent outputs across kernels.
The original CellRank algorithm description states that it detects states and assigns each cell terminal-state fate probabilities.

cases.historical_review: Figure fragments remain historical ranking diagnostics; accepted evidence is limited to explicit output definitions.

cases.expected_claim: MOFA2 performs unsupervised integration and factor analysis across multiple omics data matrices.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed MOFA documentation defines the method as unsupervised multi-omic matrix integration and factor analysis.
The governed publication record identifies MOFA+ as a framework for multi-modal data integration.

cases.historical_review: The benchmark remains valid bounded context, while the direct method and publication descriptions establish tool scope.

cases.expected_claim: MOFA2 takes several feature-by-sample omics matrices measured on the same or overlapping sample sets.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The MOFA documentation explicitly states that inputs are several data matrices across identical or overlapping sample sets.

cases.historical_review: Publication-title and benchmark summaries remain exact diagnostics but do not independently specify the input matrix contract.

cases.expected_claim: MOFA2 should not be described as universally best for clustering and is supported only within bounded factor-interpretability scope.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed benchmark explicitly rejects an overall-best clustering claim and bounds MOFA support to sparse interpretable factors.

cases.historical_review: The method homepage and publication title do not express a limitation; only the reviewed comparative benchmark is accepted.

cases.expected_claim: DoubletFinder documents PCs, pN, pK, nExp, and expected-doublet-rate choices for prediction.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The DoubletFinder documentation enumerates its algorithm stages and the PCs, pN, pK, and nExp arguments.
The governed source directly explains nExp as the pANN threshold and how to estimate it from loading and homotypic rates.

cases.historical_review: Release notes and broad workflow context remain historical candidates; accepted evidence directly defines operational parameters.

cases.expected_claim: DoubletFinder produces per-cell pANN values and thresholded doublet or singlet classifications.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The DoubletFinder algorithm description directly defines pANN and its thresholding into final doublet or singlet predictions.

cases.historical_review: Bibliography, installation, and parameter-sweep fragments remain exact diagnostics but do not independently define outputs.

cases.expected_claim: The scVelo workflow consumes spliced and unspliced quantification before velocity inference and downstream visualization.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The source explicitly orders spliced and unspliced count generation before velocyto or scVelo inference and velocity display.
The scVelo method source directly describes obtaining spliced and unspliced annotations before normalization, moments, and velocity estimation.

cases.historical_review: Bibliography and general tool-description chunks remain historical exact candidates; accepted spans directly establish workflow ordering.

cases.expected_claim: CellTypist and SingleR are source-supported approaches for reference-based cell-type annotation.

accepted_evidence.rationale: The governed source identifies CellTypist as an automated cell-type annotation tool built from a curated reference resource.
The SingleR source directly describes correlation of single-cell transcriptomes against reference transcriptomic datasets for annotation.

cases.historical_review: The broad historical pool remains an exact retrieval diagnostic; accepted evidence is limited to direct reference-annotation method statements.
